findings.source_en: There is no justice without retribution.
findings.issue: This exact quote is the inscription on the Justiciar's Sword elsewhere in the corpus ('Wielded by the magistrates of Mammon, it's inscribed with the phrase: "There is no justice without retribution."'), rendered there as «لا عدلَ بلا قِصاص». Here the same significant recurring line is translated with different words (عدالة vs عدل, اقتصاص vs قِصاص) — an inconsistency for what is meant to be the same quoted motto reappearing in dialogue.
